To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the spectrum usage is not periodic, and the spectrum usage is affected by many factors such as the number of users, their mobility, and their applications, which makes it difficult to predict; 2) the proposed prediction method based on Partial Period Pattern Mining is effective in predicting the future channel state and reducing the miss rate; 3) the proposed prediction model is more accurate in predicting channel state than the traditional prediction model based on frequent pattern mining.

the proposed PPPM method is a promising technique to predict future spectrum occupancy.
